name: handoff
description: /handoff summarizes the session into a prompt a fresh session can pick up; --new continues it in a fresh session; --save stores it; --each stores one per suggested plan; --list and --resume <id> [extra context] revisit stored handoffs

writer.title: Recap writer
writer.description: Who writes the recap. subagent (the default) starts a Haiku subagent, which also works behind an API proxy that refuses background requests. haiku asks Haiku in the background first and starts the subagent when the API refuses. conversation has the session's own model write the recap as a normal turn.
